title: Small Volume Fungal Genomic DNA Extraction Protocol for Illumina Genome
author: Jana M U'Ren
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.3w9gph6
materials: Carefully pour off ethanol into glass beaker.

steps.title: Prepare SDS Buffer
steps.instruction: Pre-measure the total amount of SDS Buffer needed for all samples (500uL per sample) into a 5 mL tube.

steps.title: Homogenize Frozen Tissue
steps.instruction: Bead beat frozen tissue in a frozen aluminum block to achieve homogenization.

substeps.instruction: Perform one 15 second cycle at 1400 RPM.
If not homogenized, repeat one 15 second cycle of grinding.
Use liquid nitrogen (drop samples in or pour over) if necessary to prevent thawing during grinding.
Place homogenized samples in a -20°C ice box.

steps.title: Lysis and Incubation
steps.instruction: Add SDS Buffer to samples and incubate to lyse cells.

substeps.instruction: Add 500uL SDS Buffer to each sample.
Vortex gently if needed to homogenize the sample in the buffer.
Incubate at 65°C for 15 minutes, gently inverting the sample 5 times every 5 minutes.

steps.title: Initial Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge and mix samples to separate components.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge samples at maximum speed (14,000 RPM) at 4°C for 5 minutes.
Invert samples 20X to mix until the appearance is 'milky white'.
Spin tubes at maximum speed at 4°C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Extract Aqueous Layer
steps.instruction: Carefully isolate the aqueous layer in a chemical fume hood.

substeps.instruction: Using a 200uL pipette, remove the aqueous layer without disturbing the interface.
Transfer the layer into new 1.5mL microcentrifuge tubes.

steps.title: Precipitate Polysaccharides
steps.instruction: Remove excess polysaccharides using a low concentration of ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.3X volume of absolute molecular grade ethanol to each tube.
Spin at maximum speed at 4°C for 15 minutes.
Carefully remove the supernatant (without disturbing the polysaccharide pellet) and place into a new 1.5mL centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Precipitate Genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Precipitate the gDNA using a higher concentration of ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.7X volume of absolute molecular grade ethanol to each tube.
Spin tube at maximum speed at 4°C for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Wash DNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet twice with 70% ethanol to remove excess salt.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.5 mL of 70% ethanol, ensuring the pellet is not disturbed.
Spin the tube at maximum speed at 4°C for 1 minute.
Repeat the addition of 1.5 mL of 70% ethanol and the 1 minute spin at maximum speed at 4°C.

steps.title: Dry and Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Remove residual ethanol and resuspend the DNA pellet.

substeps.instruction: Quick spin the tube to gather residual ethanol at the bottom and remove it with a P20 tip.
Air dry the pellet for 5 minutes at room temperature in a biosafety cabinet (do not over dry).
Resuspend the pellet in 50uL low salt TE (increase volume by 10uL if the pellet does not resuspend).

steps.title: Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Measure the concentration and purity of the extracted DNA.

substeps.instruction: Dilute samples 1:10.
Use the dilution to measure samples via Nanodrop and Qubit.
Record quantification and purity values (ng/uL, 260/280, 260/230).
Add 2 uL RNase A to the sample.
Incubate at 37°C for 1 hour.

steps.title: Final Purification
steps.instruction: Perform a final cleanup using Phenol:Chloroform:IAA in a chemical fume hood.

substeps.instruction: Carefully remove the supernatant (~500ul) without disturbing the pellet and place in a new, labeled 1.5mL centrifuge tube.
Add 500uL of Phenol:Chloroform:IAA (or use a 1:1 ratio of supernatant to P:C:IAA) to each tube.
